solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Magnanimos"** is incorrectly spelt. It should be **"Magnanimous"** which means generous or forgiving, especially towards a rival or less powerful person. (उदार)

 
 
• **Example:** He showed a** magnanimous** gesture by forgiving his opponent.
 
 
 
• **"Magnanimous"** refers to being very generous or forgiving, especially toward a rival or someone less powerful. (उदार)
 
 
• **Example:** The **magnanimous** king pardoned the traitors.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fascination** (आकर्षण): The power to attract or hold the interest; an intense interest.

 
 
• **Example:** His** fascination** with technology led him to become an engineer.
 
 
 
• **Accompanied** (साथ में): To go somewhere with someone as a companion or escort.
 
 
• **Example:** She **accompanied** her friend to the concert.
 
 
 
• **Psychology** (मनोविज्ञान): The scientific study of the human mind and its functions, especially those affecting behavior.
 
 
• **Example:** She is studying **psychology** to understand human behavior better.
